integrity: The open primary PDF was inspected at the stress–strength integral, exponential expansion, upper-incomplete-gamma series, and Table 2. The fixed-cutoff gamma asymptotic and Stirling expansion were checked against the NIST DLMF. The convergence proof is analytic, and a standalone high-precision checker replays direct integrals, convergent-series values, divergent-term behavior, and the symmetry repair.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns the gamma-series representation of stress–strength reliability, not the original integral.
It assumes the common alpha and lambda setup used in the source stress–strength derivation.
The result does not prescribe a numerically optimal summation method near equal shape exponents.
title: The UPGWD stress–strength gamma series has a sharp convergence boundary
